concepts.def: Prejudice or unfair treatment by race

walkthroughs.body_html:
UK 2021 census:

  • ~82% White.
  • ~9% Asian.
  • ~4% Black.
  • ~3% Mixed.
  • ~2% Other.

Big cities like London are far more diverse than rural areas.

UK research shows ethnic minorities often face:

  • Lower average pay.
  • Higher unemployment.
  • More stop-and-search by police.

It varies a lot between groups and isn't one story.

The Equality Act 2010 bans race discrimination.

Tools to push fairness:

  • Diversity training.
  • Mentoring.
  • Inclusive school curricula.

Work in progress. 🛠️
